searchText: Glad to have you all here. Please ask questions if you have them. Happy to clarify things. Thanks Piper. Only one Q for now: What is your favorite animal or pet ? Cheers Somewhere between a beaver, a fox, and a red panda. Beavers are badass because they build things. Foxes are clever (spirit animal?), Red pandas are cute incarnate. Interesting ! Thanks for sharing it ! I will try to picture it in my mind. Btw agreed with the spirit animals idea.
